source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role analyst) or action delete; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context partner returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means context sandbox with any role except analyst; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80. Action inspect in context partner prefers review at priority 70. Role auditor and context external prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE for role analyst) or action delete; critical cases require review.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context partner returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means context sandbox with any role except analyst; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80.
Action inspect in context partner prefers review at priority 70.
Role auditor and context external prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == analyst)) or (event.action == delete)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == sandbox) and (event.role != analyst)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.context == partner) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = review

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80, forbid label = allow

rule InspectPartner:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = review priority 70

rule AuditorExternal:
    when (event.role == auditor) and (event.context == external)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {operator, analyst}
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are deny, review, allow, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
